ebay_connected_complete.name: ebay_connected_complete
ebay_connected_complete.value: "ebay_connections"."status" <> 'connected' OR ("ebay_connections"."seller_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_connections"."seller_label" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_connections"."access" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_connections"."refresh" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_connections"."access_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_connections"."refresh_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_connections"."connected_at" IS NOT NULL)

ebay_media_fence.name: ebay_media_fence
ebay_media_fence.value: ("ebay_media_attempts"."state" IN ('preparing','not-sent') AND "ebay_media_attempts"."post_attempted_at" IS NULL) OR ("ebay_media_attempts"."state" IN ('unknown','confirmed','residual') AND "ebay_media_attempts"."post_attempted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_media_attempts"."source_digest" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_media_attempts"."export_digest" IS NOT NULL)

ebay_media_confirmed.name: ebay_media_confirmed
ebay_media_confirmed.value: "ebay_media_attempts"."state" NOT IN ('confirmed','residual') OR ("ebay_media_attempts"."returned_image_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_media_attempts"."image_url" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_media_attempts"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

ebay_media_digest.name: ebay_media_digest
ebay_media_digest.value: "ebay_media_attempts"."source_metadata_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND ("ebay_media_attempts"."source_digest" IS NULL OR "ebay_media_attempts"."source_digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$') AND ("ebay_media_attempts"."export_digest" IS NULL OR "ebay_media_attempts"."export_digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

ebay_media_fixture_identity.name: ebay_media_fixture_identity
ebay_media_fixture_identity.value: ("ebay_media_attempts"."returned_image_id" IS NULL OR "ebay_media_attempts"."returned_image_id" ~ '^fake_[a-f0-9]{32}$') AND ("ebay_media_attempts"."image_url" IS NULL OR "ebay_media_attempts"."image_url" ~ '^http://127[.]0[.]0[.]1:4313/eps/fake_[a-f0-9]{32}[.]png$')

real_media_hashes.name: real_media_hashes
real_media_hashes.value: "ebay_real_media_attempts"."seller_key" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."session_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."action_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."config_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."grant_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."source_version" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."claim_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'

real_media_bounds.name: real_media_bounds
real_media_bounds.value: length("ebay_real_media_attempts"."owner_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length("ebay_real_media_attempts"."id") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length("ebay_real_media_attempts"."listing_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length("ebay_real_media_attempts"."image_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length("ebay_real_media_attempts"."connection_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length("ebay_real_media_attempts"."connection_version") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length("ebay_real_media_attempts"."recipe") BETWEEN 1 AND 1024 AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."recipe" ~ '^[ -~]+$'

real_media_fence_shape.name: real_media_fence_shape
real_media_fence_shape.value: ("ebay_real_media_attempts"."post_intent_at" IS NULL AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."state" IN ('preparing','not-sent') AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."source_digest" IS NULL AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."derivative_digest" IS NULL AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."encoded_size" IS NULL AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."content_type" IS NULL AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."width" IS NULL AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."height" IS NULL) OR ("ebay_real_media_attempts"."post_intent_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."state" IN ('unknown','confirmed','residual') AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."source_digest" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."derivative_digest" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."encoded_size" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."content_type" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."width" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."height" IS NOT NULL)

real_media_content.name: real_media_content
real_media_content.value: ("ebay_real_media_attempts"."source_digest" IS NULL OR "ebay_real_media_attempts"."source_digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$') AND ("ebay_real_media_attempts"."derivative_digest" IS NULL OR "ebay_real_media_attempts"."derivative_digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$') AND ("ebay_real_media_attempts"."content_type" IS NULL OR "ebay_real_media_attempts"."content_type" IN ('image/jpeg','image/png')) AND ("ebay_real_media_attempts"."encoded_size" IS NULL OR "ebay_real_media_attempts"."encoded_size" BETWEEN 1 AND 10485760) AND ("ebay_real_media_attempts"."width" IS NULL OR "ebay_real_media_attempts"."width" BETWEEN 1 AND 4096) AND ("ebay_real_media_attempts"."height" IS NULL OR "ebay_real_media_attempts"."height" BETWEEN 1 AND 4096) AND ("ebay_real_media_attempts"."width" IS NULL OR greatest("ebay_real_media_attempts"."width","ebay_real_media_attempts"."height") >= 500 AND "ebay_real_media_attempts"."width"::bigint * "ebay_real_media_attempts"."height" <= 16777216)

real_media_times.name: real_media_times
real_media_times.value: isfinite("ebay_real_media_attempts"."created_at") AND isfinite("ebay_real_media_attempts"."updated_at") AND isfinite("ebay_real_media_attempts"."listing_version") AND ("ebay_real_media_attempts"."post_intent_at" IS NULL OR isfinite("ebay_real_media_attempts"."post_intent_at")) AND ("ebay_real_media_attempts"."lease_until" IS NULL OR isfinite("ebay_real_media_attempts"."lease_until")) AND ("ebay_real_media_attempts"."state" <> 'preparing' OR "ebay_real_media_attempts"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL)

real_media_receipt_level.name: real_media_receipt_level
real_media_receipt_level.value: "ebay_real_media_receipts"."level" IN ('partial','complete','conflict') AND "ebay_real_media_receipts"."fingerprint" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND ("ebay_real_media_receipts"."response_status" IS NULL OR "ebay_real_media_receipts"."response_status" BETWEEN 100 AND 599)

real_media_receipt_fields.name: real_media_receipt_fields
real_media_receipt_fields.value: ("ebay_real_media_receipts"."resource_id" IS NULL OR "ebay_real_media_receipts"."resource_id" ~ '^test_resource_[a-f0-9]{16}$') AND ("ebay_real_media_receipts"."location" IS NULL OR ("ebay_real_media_receipts"."resource_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_real_media_receipts"."location" = 'https://media-contract.invalid.test/image/' || "ebay_real_media_receipts"."resource_id")) AND ("ebay_real_media_receipts"."image_url" IS NULL OR "ebay_real_media_receipts"."image_url" ~ '^https://eps-contract[.]invalid[.]test/photo/test_visual_[a-f0-9]{16}[.]png$') AND ("ebay_real_media_receipts"."maximum_url" IS NULL OR "ebay_real_media_receipts"."maximum_url" ~ '^https://eps-contract[.]invalid[.]test/photo/test_visual_[a-f0-9]{16}[.]png$') AND ("ebay_real_media_receipts"."expires_at" IS NULL OR isfinite("ebay_real_media_receipts"."expires_at")) AND isfinite("ebay_real_media_receipts"."created_at")

real_media_receipt_complete.name: real_media_receipt_complete
real_media_receipt_complete.value: "ebay_real_media_receipts"."level" <> 'complete' OR ("ebay_real_media_receipts"."resource_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_real_media_receipts"."location" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_real_media_receipts"."image_url" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_real_media_receipts"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ebay_real_media_receipts"."response_status" = 201)

image_source_valid.name: image_source_valid
image_source_valid.value: ("listing_images"."storage_provider" = 'filename' AND "listing_images"."pathname" IS NULL AND "listing_images"."content_type" IS NULL AND "listing_images"."byte_size" IS NULL AND "listing_images"."uploaded_at" IS NULL) OR ("listing_images"."storage_provider" = 'vercel-blob' AND "listing_images"."pathname" IS NOT NULL AND "listing_images"."content_type" IN ('image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp') AND "listing_images"."content_type" IS NOT NULL AND "listing_images"."byte_size" > 0 AND "listing_images"."byte_size" <= 10485760 AND "listing_images"."byte_size" IS NOT NULL AND "listing_images"."uploaded_at" IS NOT NULL)

publication_price_valid.name: publication_price_valid
publication_price_valid.value: ("marketplace_listings"."price_override_amount" IS NULL AND "marketplace_listings"."price_override_currency" IS NULL) OR ("marketplace_listings"."price_override_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "marketplace_listings"."price_override_currency" IS NOT NULL AND "marketplace_listings"."price_override_amount" >= 0 AND "marketplace_listings"."price_override_amount" < 'Infinity'::numeric AND "marketplace_listings"."price_override_currency" = 'USD')
